source.name: Colourful urban birds: Urban-tolerant birds have more elaborate colours, more blue and less brown
source.citation: Dunning, C. R. et al. (2025) Colourful urban birds: Urban-tolerant birds have more elaborate colours, more blue and less brown. Data: https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.jq2bvq8jg

note: 雄/雌各 12 类羽色占体表面积的比例（black/white/blue/red/green/purple/yellow/grey.dark/grey.light/brown.dark/brown.light/rufous）+ 色彩复杂度 + 雌雄异色判定 + 营巢位置与领域性。**这是稀疏层**：源表仅 2,541 种，覆盖率见 counts（不是万种全有）。Diet/ForStrat/BodyMass 三列刻意不取（EltonTraits / AVONET 已有，避免同一事实两个来源）。每条 source.sha256 可用于校验原始 xlsx。
